lines.text: A command is a saved prompt behind a slash.
Type a slash and its name, and the agent runs it.
Built-in ones run the session itself: /clear starts fresh, /compact summarizes,|/context shows what's loaded, and /model switches models.
lines.say: Built-in ones run the session itself: slash clear starts fresh, slash compact summarizes, slash context shows what's loaded, and slash model switches models.

lines.text: Your own commands are now part of skills.
A file at .claude/commands/deploy.md and a skill at .claude/skills/deploy|both give you /deploy.
lines.say: A file at dot claude slash commands slash deploy dot M D, and a skill at dot claude slash skills slash deploy, both give you slash deploy.

lines.text: Whatever you type after the name arrives as $ARGUMENTS,|so /deploy staging passes the word staging.
lines.say: Whatever you type after the name arrives as dollar arguments, so slash deploy staging passes the word staging.

lines.text: Put one in your home .claude folder instead, and it follows you into every project.
lines.say: Put one in your home dot claude folder instead, and it follows you into every project.

lines.text: Its frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation to true,|so only you can trigger it.
lines.say: Its frontmatter sets disable model invocation to true, so only you can trigger it.

lines.text: Its body is just the steps, in plain words:|build, run the checks, then deploy to the environment you named.
You don't want an agent deciding to deploy because the code looks ready.
And until you run it, its description stays out of context entirely.
The signal to make one: you've typed the same opening prompt again.
Commit it to the project's .claude folder, and the whole team gets the same command.
lines.say: Commit it to the project's dot claude folder, and the whole team gets the same command.

lines.text: Keep anything with side effects, like deploys and commits, manual.
Codex has its own built-ins, like /init, /review and /model.
lines.say: Codex has its own built-ins, like slash init, slash review and slash model.

lines.text: Its custom prompts are deprecated,|so for your own commands in Codex, write a skill.
